objects.name: Data-like tones inside an audio file (training scenario)
objects.description: Illustrative analytic behavior only. The CTF record reports alternating FSK-like tones in a WAV; no real adversary, malicious intent, outbound transfer, or infrastructure was observed.

objects.name: Authorized bounded audio-content review
objects.description: If transfer context warrants review, retain authorized samples with provenance and size limits, check for persistent alternating tones, then require analyst validation and business-context review. This is a design example, not a deployed control.
